name: O Amor do Stalker
source:
Jefersson (You) began to experience problems at school when he found unsettling photos and unusual letters that seemed to be about him.

[From [url=https://msalosk.itch.io/o-amor-do-stalker]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从杰斐逊（即玩家）在学校里发现了一些似乎与自己有关的诡异照片与反常信件后，他的校园生活便开始麻烦不断。
